description:
[Trading Data API] Polymarket prediction markets with live probabilities: question, per-outcome probability, 24h and total volume, liquidity, best bid/ask, one-day price change and end date. Top markets by volume, liquidity or soonest end, or free-text search.

**Example:** `/v1/polymarket?q=bitcoin&limit=5`

Use when you want Polymarket markets with live per-outcome probabilities and volume. Not for Kalshi markets (use kalshi_probability).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

q.description: Optional. Free-text search, e.g. bitcoin, fed rate, election.

sort.description: Optional. volume (default), liquidity or ending. Ignored when q is set.

name: polymarket
